changenote:
v0.5.30 - Workshop settings and damage display fixes

- Load the cooked F3 widget class directly, without an AssetRegistry entry or enabling the global BPModLoader.
- Recreate the settings widget after closing; restore game input if opening fails.
- Restore total damage, DPS and per-skill damage/DPS in the tablet HUD while retaining loadout grouping and percentages.
- Correct BindPrimitiveComponent to its declaring PalHitFilter class and ignore non-attack filters. No relaxed timing or hit-count rules.
- Retain the v0.5.29 HUD shutdown and idle-update fixes. UE4SS and PalSchema are not modified.
- Offline regressions cover these paths. Fully exit Palworld, wait for Steam to update, then restart and verify F3 and combat in-game.

v0.5.30 - 工坊設定面板與傷害顯示修正

- F3 直接載入已烘焙的面板類別，不再要求資產索引或啟用全域 BPModLoader。
- 關閉設定後重新建立面板；開啟失敗時還原遊戲輸入。
- 石板 HUD 恢復總傷害、DPS 與各技能傷害／DPS，保留配招分組及占比。
- 修正 BindPrimitiveComponent 所屬的 PalHitFilter 路徑，排除非攻擊 Filter；不放寬時間或命中次數限制。
- 保留 v0.5.29 HUD 退出與閒置更新修正，不修改 UE4SS 或 PalSchema。
- 已納入離線回歸；請完整退出遊戲，等 Steam 更新後重開，再驗證 F3 與實戰。
